hoomd
=====

The ``snap_simulate.hoomd`` module provides tools for declarative HOOMD-blue simulation construction, dynamic box compression, and autocorrelation-driven equilibrium execution.

Simulation Operations
---------------------

The primary simulation workflows are built and driven by the following functions:

.. toctree::
   :maxdepth: 1

   hoomd/build_simulation
   hoomd/remaining_steps
   hoomd/shrink_box
   hoomd/minimize_autocorrelation
